scope: independent simulation atomic-operation online RL feasibility; not the old reliable-Anchor Phase16
historical_baseline: Phase14.3 C validation-selected Normal pi05; five frozen training seeds
base_pairing: RL seed i uses historical Normal seed i; A/B/C/D within each seed share exactly that checkpoint; no best-seed selection

action.gripper: base output preserved byte-for-byte; original sign-to-binary mapping

randomization.handle: rigid fixture translation and articulated door; no independently randomized handle geometry
randomization.actual_angle: record reset before first policy and at tick30; do not claim sustained initial-angle generalization if closing drive removes variation

termination.failure: 600 tick timeout or measured nonfinite physical state or arm outside hard joint limits by >0.001 rad
termination.contact_loss_stall_regression: logged diagnostic flags, never used to censor difficult episodes
termination.collision: retain original Isaac physical collision shapes/controller; no unobserved arm collision claimed measured

reset_engineering_v2: after native q/qd reset explicitly clear robot position/velocity/effort drive targets to default and cabinet targets to historical closed-drive nominal; no extra physics ticks or held random door angle; applied to A/B/C/D before any new baseline or RL
independent_rollout_process_v4: fresh physics process for each independent A/B/zero/small/medium or sampled/mean evaluation rollout, persistent frozen inference; no extra physics ticks; each rollout preserves ordinary within-rollout automatic resets and budget. Attempts1/2 proved q/qd-only reset retained history; attempt6 fresh stage in the same process also differed. Four independent original A process traces were byte-identical. A/B allocate the same unused untrained residual network to control allocation footprint; no updates. All groups follow this protocol before baseline or RL.
reward_C: original reach +0.5 bilateral grasp +20 positive angular velocity +600 success; integrated dt=1/60
reward_D: original integrated reward minus20 positive next angular velocity*dt plus20*(next_angle-previous_angle); all other terms identical

residual.physical_command_bound: 2mm per XYZ and6mrad per rotation command; IK/physical displacement measured separately
residual.zero_init: zero actor mean head, log_std=-4; deterministic residual exactly0; sampled initial policy is a distinct small stochastic distribution

sac.actor_state: bounded standardized39 robot+GT, current base7, complete frozen10x7 chunk and cursor onehot5
sac.critic: same context plus proposed residual6 and actual composed action7; clipping is in the actor gradient graph
sac.entropy: tanh Gaussian in unit residual coordinates, exact Jacobian; no claim clipped executed distribution has this density

resources.inference: persistent per seed task; historical graph engine verification against original frozen flow sampler

evaluation.node_rounding: 25008 is the first whole16env batch above25k; final budget exactly50000
evaluation.selection: validation sampled success then earlier step only; final50k is primary, best diagnostic separate
evaluation.test_use: step0 baseline and final/best independent test; test never candidate selection
evaluation.A_B_nodes: frozen deterministic control law with same pi flow sampling, reused paired evaluations because no updates; costs counted once
evaluation.training_during_evaluation: training physics stays idle with exact live state and chunk intact; evaluation uses separate process/environment, no reset of ongoing training episodes

preflights: real small/medium residual changes command and physical state with unchanged gripper

stop.severe_degradation: two consecutive validation nodes sampled success >20pp below paired A validation

statistics.extension: only after final RL gain, continuous successes, stable sampled policy, acceptable drift and final-best gap; 5+seeds independent confirmation required
statistics.unit: seed, not physical tick or episode
statistics.old_success_rates: not used as same-test treatment effect
